raw.query: WITH m AS (SELECT source_path, engine, image_px, n_images, mean_ms, ms_per_img, is_valid, note FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/oneworker_artifact/silicon_burst5.json' AND engine = 'aic' AND image_px = 448 AND n_images IN (1,64)), e AS (SELECT MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 1) AS f1_ms, MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 64) AS f64_total_ms, MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 64) / 64.0 AS f64_ms_per_image, (MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 1)) / (MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 64) / 64.0) AS throughput_gain_x, BOOL_AND(is_valid) AS all_valid, COUNT(*) AS measurement_rows FROM m), c AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS current_cost_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_ratio BETWEEN 1.645 AND 1.655) AS current_cost_rows_near_1_65, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE denominator_worker_seconds IS NULL OR denominator_worker_seconds <= 0) AS invalid_denominator_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE denominator_window_mismatch) AS denominator_window_mismatch_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT window_name) AS represented_windows FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current = true) SELECT e.f1_ms, e.f64_total_ms, e.f64_ms_per_image, e.throughput_gain_x, e.all_valid, e.measurement_rows, c.current_cost_rows, c.current_cost_rows_near_1_65, c.invalid_denominator_rows, c.denominator_window_mismatch_rows, c.represented_windows FROM e CROSS JOIN c
